title: Analytical Procedures (Related Substances IM2)[Purity][CP-7]
description: Core quality information (2.3.3.AP) for Analytical Procedures (Related Substances IM2)[Purity][CP-7].

action.title: Column
action.description: Silica C18 3,5 µm 250x4.6 mm or equivalent

action.title: Test solution
action.description: Approximately 1.0 mg/ml of sample to be examined in diluent. (Acentonitril:phosphate buffer (1:4))

action.title: Reference solution
action.description: Approximately 0.001 mg/ml of CP-7 standard in diluent.

action.title: System Suitability Criteria
action.description: Resolution > 1.5  Reproducibility (n=6) < 10 %                                                                                           RSD of the six areas obtained for the peak should be less than 10%.

action.title: Calculation
action.description: The specified and unspecified degradation products are calculated against CP-7 in the reference solution with the corresponding Response correction factor (RF). IWP =  integration value of the by-product or degradation product in the test solution IWR =  integration value of the by-product or degradation product in the reference solution PR =    initial concentration of the reference substance [mg/mL] PP =    initial concentration of the substance [mg/mL] C =     content of the reference substance, in % 50*      exemplary dilution factor
